title: Walk Anyway
decides: Four shots of one place and two people, 26 s, with a card at each end: how small must the clips be?
setting: A short film at night in steady rain: a glass bus shelter on an empty city street, wet asphalt, cool blue streetlight with warm reflections. Sound is rain only; no music, no narrator.

subjects.words: A tall woman with a silver bob, a red raincoat and yellow boots
An older man with a grey beard, a green coat and a black umbrella

beats.text: A title card: a plain solid black background with the words in white capital letters, centred.
Wide shot. The woman waits alone at the bus stop and looks down the empty street.
The man walks up with his umbrella open and stops beside her.
Close on both of them. He says out loud, once: "You came back." She smiles. Nobody else speaks.
Seen from behind, they walk away together down the street under the umbrella.
A title card: a plain solid black background with the words in white capital letters, centred.
